scope: Independent NumPy-only recalculation from 27 completed wave-1 native result.pkl files. No finalizer metric helpers imported. BATCH4 and checkpoint evaluation excluded.

method.last10: Last ten training rows: itr129 and itr131-139
method.dispersion: sample SD across seeds, ddof=1; three defined values required for a mean
method.kl: Median within each seed, then mean/sample SD over three seed medians; pooled median reported separately
method.noise: Nonoverlapping 10-iteration windows each hold 9 training rows; B_env=10*sum(split_diff_sq)/sum(split_dot), undefined if sum(split_dot)<=0. Per-run median uses defined windows only, with missing-window counts retained.
method.collapse: Any eval below 50% of own itr0, or any numeric NaN/inf. Null unavailable diagnostics do not count as non-finite.
method.comparison: abs(meanB-meanA) < 2*sqrt((sdA^2+sdB^2)/2) is unresolved; no further significance tests.
method.phase1_uncertainty_warning: Known unreliable Phase-1 percentile intervals and CI-based resolution/bounds are excluded entirely.
